reason: I'd definitely try the free tricks, but I only pay for magic stuff when there's a show or a birthday coming up, and nothing's on this week. Also an app installed from the browser instead of the App Store makes me wonder if it'll look like the real gallery or calculator.
objection: If the fake gallery or the incoming call looks even a bit off from the real iPhone screen, my friends will spot it right away and the trick is dead.
would_change_my_mind: A free trick that actually fools my family at dinner, plus a birthday or show coming up soon.
